attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "This refactor removes/renames several protected internal members (e.g. DefaultCategory, DefaultPriority, ListDelims\u2192ListDelimiters, GetValues) and changes the Id setter's exception type from InvalidOperationException to ArgumentException on FeatureAttribute/ModuleAttribute, which are core extensibility points used by every module/theme in the ecosystem via assembly-level attributes and possible subclassing, so downstream modules relying on the old API surface or exception type could break at compile or runtime."}
